what: Normalisation constants for the aggregate primary outcome J, derived from the development comparator campaign.
provenance: POST-FREEZE derivation from PRE-FREEZE data. EVALUATION_METRICS_SPEC 1.1 requires these constants to be computed from development data and written into the freeze record; they were not, because nothing computed them ahead of time -- aggregate_outcome derives them from whatever rows it is given. This file records them from the development campaign that existed before the freeze, so that held-out results can be scored on the development ruler as the spec intends. It is NOT a pre-registered constant and must not be described as one.
weights_note: The weight vector IS cryptographically fixed: it is analysis.DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, and analysis.py's digest is in the freeze record. Only the normalisation constants were left to runtime.
c1_invariance_check: C1 selection was tested under both the sweep-self normalisers and these constants on the development sweep: identical winner (camera_coaxial+usbl@3.0m/0.25mps/gate/continue) and identical top four. The baseline does not depend on this choice.
